gaps.title: Missing real OAuth2/OIDC implementation and defined endpoints
gaps.jtbd: When a user logs in via Moodle, I want the system to perform a real OAuth2/OIDC token exchange and user profile fetch against the Moodle identity provider, so that the integration is secure and relies on real external LMS data rather than hardcoded mock tokens.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a Moodle SSO request, When the callback endpoint is hit with an auth code, Then the system exchanges it for a real token and fetches the Moodle profile.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement asks for 'SSO (OAuth2 / OIDC / LTI)'. The actual code uses a mocked method 'fetchMoodleProfile' checking for 'mock_valid_moodle_token', and the /auth/moodle/config and /auth/moodle/callback endpoints defined in Auth.openapi.yaml are entirely missing.

gaps.title: Missing client ID and secret configuration for OAuth2 provider
gaps.jtbd: When configuring the Moodle SSO, I want to be able to supply a client ID and client secret, so that the application can securely authenticate itself to the Moodle identity provider during the OAuth2 token exchange.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is starting, When it initializes the SSO module, Then it requires and loads the Moodle OAuth2 client ID and secret from the configuration.
gaps.reason: Domain-standard expectation: Any standard OAuth2/OIDC SSO integration requires configuring a client ID, client secret, and provider URLs to perform the secure authorization code exchange flow. These are absent from the codebase.
